beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You chair the choir. You announce the cancelled tour; I'll distribute the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser who cancelled it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my report must travel upward before the bad news travels outward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not before the chair introduces the emotionally difficult item. I'm ready with the forms.

before.seedUse: The choir cancellation and house sale are Drive seeds; delegating the announcement up the authority chain embodies the Stance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You’re the headteacher. You should tell the parents I lost the class hamster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You’re its teacher. You tell them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can supply the facts. Bad news should come from a senior position.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I’ll appoint you deputy head for the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first recommendation is that we hear from the headteacher.

after.seedUse: Uses procedural routing from S67-single-a and the delegated bad-news opening from D101-single-a. The school and lost hamster are a new illustrative setting, not inherited source facts. B promotes A to remove the stated obstacle; A uses that promotion to route the same difficult announcement upward again.
